# Drive Exotiq

> Drive Exotiq is the community front door to the exotiq.rent exotic-car marketplace.

An Exotiq Inc. brand. Built for the people who actually drive the car.

What we do: exotic car rentals (coming soon) via exotiq.rent — McLaren, Porsche, Lamborghini, Ferrari, Rolls-Royce, Aston Martin, G-Wagon. Curated, invite-only sunrise drives on the last Sunday of every month, each ending in a curated Cars & Coffee. Event and brand partnerships, including the 2026 Denver→Miami tour — one car, ten markets, about 5,000 miles — currently seeking a wrap sponsor.

Ecosystem: Drive Exotiq (community) → exotiq.rent (marketplace) → exotiq.ai (intelligence).

## Pages

- [Drive Exotiq](https://driveexotiq.com/): the cinematic scroll film home — the fleet, the drives, and the tour
- [Get on the list](https://driveexotiq.com/apply): waitlist for the marketplace, drives, and Cars & Coffee
- [Sponsor the wrap](https://driveexotiq.com/sponsor): tour wrap sponsorship and event partnerships
- [The tour](https://driveexotiq.com/tour): the 2026 Denver→Miami tour
